| # VDD5A ECU internal reference voltage {#vdd5a-ecu-internal-reference-voltage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                       |                                                                                                                                                             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The cyclic check of the ECU internal voltage 5V via analog feedback.

 

## Remarks: {#remarks .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- Monitoring of overvoltage and undervoltage for error.

- Only Errors are indicated.

- Over Voltage Error Limit = 5.050V

- Under Voltage Error Limit = 4.950V

- Refer [Safety function and safe state](safetyfunctionandsafestate.html){.topiclink} for details on the safety functions provided by the RCs and the related considerations to be observed.

- Refer [Failure detection possibilities](failuredetectionpossibilities.html){.topiclink} for a broader overview of the different failure reactions observed.

 

Error Reaction:

 

- Over Voltage Error (VDD5A \> Over Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ ----------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_moOV_FirstConstADC
  Error Code                     0x082C00
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  100ms

 

- Under Voltage Error (VDD5A  \< Under Voltage Error Limit)

  Error Description              Reaction
  ------------------------------ ----------------------------
  DFC                            DFC_rbr_moUV_FirstConstADC
  Error Code                     0x082D00
  High Power Outputs(\...,OFF)   yes
  ECU Reset                      no
  Reaction time                  100ms
